{"CodeContent":"# 🔐 Keamanan & Autentikasi

Sistem keamanan multi-layer GKI.ONE.

---

## 1. Metode Autentikasi

### 1.1 Password Login (Standard)
- Odoo session authentication via JSON-RPC
- Session cookie management
- Next.js middleware route protection

### 1.2 Passkey / WebAuthn (`auth_passkey`)
- Passwordless login menggunakan biometrik (fingerprint, face ID)
- FIDO2 standard
- Komponen: `PasskeyLoginButton`, `PasskeyManager`, `PasskeyRecommendationBanner`
- Multi-device support

### 1.3 Device Auth — RFC 8628 (`church_device_auth`)
- Untuk TV & Smart Display tanpa keyboard
- 6-digit pairing code + QR code
- OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant
- Auto-cleanup expired codes (cron)
- Support: Android TV, Apple TV, Fire TV

### 1.4 Auth Bridge (`church_auth_bridge`)
- Cross-system authentication: CMS (Odoo 12) ↔ RKA (Odoo 16)
- Auto-create local user jika belum ada
- Password sync setelah remote auth berhasil
- Configurable via System Parameters

### 1.5 Brute Force Protection (`auth_brute_force`)
- Tracking failed login per IP & username
- Auto-block setelah threshold

---

## 2. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

### 2.1 User Roles (Frontend Detection)
```typescript
interface UserAccess {
    dashboard: boolean;           // Dashboard Saya
    profile: boolean;             // Profil Jemaat
    purj: boolean;                // PURJ (Potret)
    finance: boolean;             // Keuangan
    asset: boolean;               // Aset
    elearning: boolean;           // eLearning
    myprofile: boolean;           // Profil Saya
    sdm_gereja: boolean;          // SDM Gereja
    anggota: boolean;             // Anggota
    analitik: boolean;            // Analitik
    forum: boolean;               // Forum
    messages: boolean;            // Pesan
    kelola_klasis: boolean;       // Admin Klasis
    kelola_sinodewilayah: boolean; // Admin Sinode Wilayah
    kelola_sinode: boolean;       // Admin Sinode
    litbang_klasis: boolean;      // Litbang Klasis (read-only)
    litbang_sinodewilayah: boolean; // Litbang SW (read-only)
    litbang_sinode: boolean;      // Litbang Sinode (read-only)
}
```

### 2.2 Odoo Security Groups
- **CMS Groups** (`church_base`): Base security groups
- **Pendeta Security** (`church_hr`): SDM access
- **Program Security** (`church_program`): RKA access
- **Evaluation Security** (`church_evaluation`): PURJ access
- **Litbang Security** (`church_evaluation`): Research access
- **Dashboard Security** (`church_dashboard_builder`): Dashboard access
- **Pastoral Visit Groups** (`church_crm`): CRM access
- **Asset Security** (`church_asset`): Asset per jemaat
- **Room Security** (`church_room`): Room management
- **Portal Security** (`church_portal`): Portal user filtering

### 2.3 Litbang Hierarchy
Litbang (Penelitian & Pengembangan) memiliki akses read-only berjenjang:
- **Litbang Klasis**: Akses data evaluasi jemaat dalam klasis
- **Litbang Sinode Wilayah**: Akses data evaluasi semua klasis dalam SW
- **Litbang Sinode**: Akses data evaluasi seluruh organisasi

### 2.4 Record Rules (ir.rule)
- Jemaat admin hanya melihat jemaat yang dikelola
- Anggota hanya melihat data dalam jemaatnya
- Klasis admin melihat semua jemaat dalam klasis
- SW admin melihat semua klasis dalam SW

---

## 3. Admin Features

### 3.1 Admin Impersonate (`admin_user_impersonate`)
- Admin bisa login sebagai user lain untuk debugging
- Audit trail impersonation

### 3.2 Login History (`church_management_base`)
- Tracking login per user
- IP address, timestamp, user agent

---

## 4. API Security

### 4.1 Rate Limiting (`rateLimit.ts`)
- Client-side rate limiting
- Prevent API abuse

### 4.2 Session Validation
- Next.js middleware validates session on every request
- Redirect to login if session expired

### 4.3 CORS
- Configured per deployment
- Whitelist allowed origins

{"CodeContent":"# 🔌 Integrasi & API

Daftar integrasi pihak ketiga dan API layer GKI.ONE.

---

## 1. API Layer (`odoo-api-16`)

### 1.1 Arsitektur
- **Framework**: Python FastAPI
- **Entry point**: `src/main.py` → `src/app.py`
- **Fungsi**: Bridge antara Next.js frontend dan Odoo backend
- **Protokol**: JSON-RPC + REST

### 1.2 Odoo JSON-RPC Endpoints
Frontend berkomunikasi dengan Odoo melalui proxy Next.js API routes:
- `/web/session/authenticate` — Login
- `/web/session/destroy` — Logout
- `/web/dataset/call_kw` — Model method calls
- `/web/dataset/search_read` — Data queries

---

## 2. Integrasi Pihak Ketiga

### 2.1 Immich Photo Gallery (`church_immich`)
- **Fungsi**: Sinkronisasi foto dan face matching
- **API**: Immich REST API
- **Fitur**:
  - Sync People data dari Immich
  - Face matching anggota jemaat
  - Display foto terkait
  - Cron job otomatis

### 2.2 Navidrome Music Server (`church_management_navidrome`)
- **Fungsi**: Streaming audio lagu gereja
- **API**: Navidrome/Subsonic API
- **Fitur**: Database lagu terintegrasi

### 2.3 Google Maps
- **Fungsi**: Profil bisnis gereja di Google
- **Data**: Rating, reviews, status operasional
- **Field**: `googlemap_data` JSON di model jemaat

### 2.4 Leaflet Maps
- **Fungsi**: Peta interaktif di frontend
- **Library**: Leaflet + React-Leaflet + Leaflet Draw
- **Fitur**: Markers, clusters, polygon editor, satellite view

### 2.5 SMS Gateway (`sms_gateway_client`)
- **Fungsi**: Kirim SMS notifikasi
- **Library**: Jinja2 templating
- **Fitur**: Compose wizard, tracking, server actions

### 2.6 Telegram Integration
- **Fungsi**: Pengingat kunjungan pastoral (`church_crm`)
- **Channel**: Notification bot

### 2.7 Augmented Reality (`church_ar`)
- **Fungsi**: AR content untuk buku fisik
- **Platform**: WebAR / native AR

---

## 3. Frontend Libraries & Integrations

| Library | Versi | Fungsi |
|---------|-------|--------|
| **Recharts** | 3.7 | Charting (Bar, Line, Pie, Area, Composed) |
| **Leaflet** | 1.9 | Peta interaktif |
| **React-Leaflet** | 4.2 | React wrapper untuk Leaflet |
| **React-Leaflet-Cluster** | 4.0 | Marker clustering |
| **React-Leaflet-Draw** | 0.20 | Polygon drawing tools |
| **React Quill** | 2.0 | Rich text editor (WYSIWYG) |
| **React Grid Layout** | 2.2 | Drag & drop dashboard layout |
| **SheetJS (xlsx)** | 0.18 | Excel/CSV import-export |
| **jsPDF** | 4.2 | PDF generation |
| **jspdf-autotable** | 5.0 | PDF table generation |
| **html2canvas-pro** | 2.0 | DOM to canvas (screenshot) |
| **date-fns** | 4.1 | Date manipulation |

---

## 4. Multi-Platform Clients

### 4.1 GKI.ONE Web (`gki-one/`)
- **Tech**: Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, TailwindCSS
- **Mode**: PWA-ready
- **Target**: Desktop & mobile browser

### 4.2 GKI Mobile (`gki-mobile/`)
- **Tech**: Flutter (Dart)
- **Platforms**: iOS, Android, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux
- **Features**: Alkitab, calendar, events, renungan, PDF viewer
- **Auth**: Session-based + public endpoints

### 4.3 Lumina Desktop (`lumina/`)
- **Tech**: Flutter (Dart)
- **Platforms**: Windows, macOS, Linux
- **Fungsi**: Operator ibadah (proyeksi slide, lirik, liturgi real-time)

### 4.4 Device Auth (`device-auth/`)
- **Fungsi**: Companion app untuk TV/Smart Display pairing

### 4.5 SonicVault (`sonicvault/`)
- **Fungsi**: Audio processing & music management

---

## 5. Deployment Architecture

```
Internet
    │
    ├── pfSense Firewall (GeoIP filtering)
    │
    ├── Apache Reverse Proxy (HTTPS, security headers)
    │   ├── → Odoo 16 (port 8069)
    │   ├── → GKI.ONE Next.js (port 3000)
    │   ├── → WordPress (PHP)
    │   └── → Navidrome (port 4533)
    │
    └── fail2ban (brute force protection)
```

### 5.1 Infrastructure Stack
- **Firewall**: pfSense
- **Web Server**: Apache (reverse proxy)
- **App Server**: Odoo 16 + Node.js (Next.js)
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15
- **Music**: Navidrome
- **Photos**: Immich
- **CMS Legacy**: WordPress
- **Security**: fail2ban, GeoIP blocking

---

## 6. Data Flow

```
User Action (Browser/App)
     │
     ▼
Next.js API Route (/api/*)
     │
     ▼
Odoo JSON-RPC (server-side fetch)
     │
     ▼
Odoo ORM (search_read / call_kw)
     │
     ▼
PostgreSQL Query
     │
     ▼
Response → JSON → React State → UI Render
```

### 2.7 Augmented Reality (`church_ar`)
- **Fungsi**: AR content untuk buku fisik
- **Platform**: WebAR / native AR

---

## 3. Frontend Libraries & Integrations

| Library | Versi | Fungsi |
|---------|-------|--------|
| **Recharts** | 3.7 | Charting (Bar, Line, Pie, Area, Composed) |
| **Leaflet** | 1.9 | Peta interaktif |
| **React-Leaflet** | 4.2 | React wrapper untuk Leaflet |
| **React-Leaflet-Cluster** | 4.0 | Marker clustering |
| **React-Leaflet-Draw** | 0.20 | Polygon drawing tools |
| **React Quill** | 2.0 | Rich text editor (WYSIWYG) |
| **React Grid Layout** | 2.2 | Drag & drop dashboard layout |
| **SheetJS (xlsx)** | 0.18 | Excel/CSV import-export |
| **jsPDF** | 4.2 | PDF generation |
| **jspdf-autotable** | 5.0 | PDF table generation |
| **html2canvas-pro** | 2.0 | DOM to canvas (screenshot) |
| **date-fns** | 4.1 | Date manipulation |

---

## 4. Multi-Platform Clients

### 4.1 GKI.ONE Web (`gki-one/`)
- **Tech**: Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, TailwindCSS
- **Mode**: PWA-ready
- **Target**: Desktop & mobile browser

### 4.2 GKI Mobile (`gki-mobile/`)
- **Tech**: Flutter (Dart)
- **Platforms**: iOS, Android, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux
- **Features**: Alkitab, calendar, events, renungan, PDF viewer
- **Auth**: Session-based + public endpoints

### 4.3 Lumina Desktop (`lumina/`)
- **Tech**: Flutter (Dart)
- **Platforms**: Windows, macOS, Linux
- **Fungsi**: Operator ibadah (proyeksi slide, lirik, liturgi real-time)

### 4.4 Device Auth (`device-auth/`)
- **Fungsi**: Companion app untuk TV/Smart Display pairing

### 4.5 SonicVault (`sonicvault/`)
- **Fungsi**: Audio processing & music management

---

## 5. Deployment Architecture

```
Internet
    │
    ├── pfSense Firewall (GeoIP filtering)
    │
    ├── Apache Reverse Proxy (HTTPS, security headers)
    │   ├── → Odoo 16 (port 8069)
    │   ├── → GKI.ONE Next.js (port 3000)
    │   ├── → WordPress (PHP)
    │   └── → Navidrome (port 4533)
    │
    └── fail2ban (brute force protection)
```

### 5.1 Infrastructure Stack
- **Firewall**: pfSense
- **Web Server**: Apache (reverse proxy)
- **App Server**: Odoo 16 + Node.js (Next.js)
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15
- **Music**: Navidrome
- **Photos**: Immich
- **CMS Legacy**: WordPress
- **Security**: fail2ban, GeoIP blocking

---

## 6. Data Flow

```
User Action (Browser/App)
     │
     ▼
Next.js API Route (/api/*)
     │
     ▼
Odoo JSON-RPC (server-side fetch)
     │
     ▼
Odoo ORM (search_read / call_kw)
     │
     ▼
PostgreSQL Query
     │
     ▼
Response → JSON → React State → UI Render
```

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-

import json
import base64
import io
from odoo import models, fields, api


class ChurchAsset(models.Model):
    _name = 'church.asset'
    _description = 'Aset Gereja'
    _inherit = ['account.asset', 'mail.thread', 'mail.activity.mixin']
    _order = 'jemaat_id, category_id, name'

    # Fix Many2many table collision: account.asset.group_ids and church.asset.group_ids
    # both auto-generate the same relation table. Override with explicit table name.
    group_ids = fields.Many2many(
        comodel_name='account.asset.group',
        relation='church_asset_group_rel',
        column1='asset_id',
        column2='group_id',
        compute='_compute_group_ids',
        readonly=False,
        store=True,
        string='Asset Groups',
    )

    # Override account.asset required fields to make them optional
    # (not all church assets need full accounting setup)
    name = fields.Char(string='Nama Aset', required=True, tracking=True)
    journal_id = fields.Many2one('account.journal', required=False)
    account_asset_id = fields.Many2one('account.account', required=False)
    account_depreciation_id = fields.Many2one('account.account', required=False)
    account_expense_depreciation_id = fields.Many2one('account.account', required=False)
    method_number = fields.Integer(required=False, default=0)
    method_period = fields.Selection(required=False)
    state = fields.Selection(default='draft')

    code = fields.Char(
        string='Kode Aset',
        readonly=True,
        copy=False,
        default='New',
    )
    jemaat_id = fields.Many2one(
        comodel_name='jemaat.jemaat',
        string='Jemaat',
        required=True,
        tracking=True,
        ondelete='restrict',
    )
    # currency_id inherited from account.asset
    category_id = fields.Many2one(
        comodel_name='church.asset.category',
        string='Kategori',
        tracking=True,
        ondelete='restrict',
    )
    description = fields.Text(
        string='Deskripsi',
    )
    
    # acquisition_date inherited from account.asset
    acquisition_year = fields.Char(
        string='Tahun Perolehan',
        compute='_compute_acquisition_year',
        store=True,
        readonly=False,
        help='Dapat diisi otomatis dari tanggal perolehan atau diisi manual',
    )
    # original_value inherited from account.asset (Nilai Perolehan)
    
    # Location & Condition
    location = fields.Char(
        string='Lokasi',
        help='Lokasi fisik aset di dalam gedung/area jemaat',
    )
    condition = fields.Selection(
        selection=[
            ('baik', 'Baik'),
            ('cukup', 'Cukup'),
            ('rusak_ringan', 'Rusak Ringan'),
            ('rusak_berat', 'Rusak Berat'),
        ],
        string='Kondisi',
        default='baik',
        tracking=True,
    )
    status = fields.Selection(
        selection=[
            ('active', 'Aktif'),
            ('maintenance', 'Dalam Perbaikan'),
            ('disposed', 'Dihapuskan'),
        ],
        string='Status',
        default='active',
        tracking=True,
    )
    
    # Additional Information
    notes = fields.Text(
        string='Catatan',
    )
    image = fields.Binary(
        string='Foto',
        attachment=True,
    )
    image_preview = fields.Binary(
        string='Preview Foto',
        compute='_compute_image_preview',
        store=False,
        help='Preview foto aset. Jika foto kosong dan ada data bentuk tanah, akan menampilkan thumbnail bentuk tanah.',
    )
    is_land_category = fields.Boolean(
        related='category_id.is_land_category',
        string='Kategori Tanah',
        store=True,
    )
    
    # Property/Land Information (multi-use for land, buildings, etc.)
    area_size = fields.Float(
        string='Luas',
        digits=(16, 2),
        help='Luas tanah/bangunan dalam meter persegi (m²)',
    )
    area_unit = fields.Selection(
        selection=[
            ('m2', 'm²'),
            ('ha', 'Hektar'),
            ('are', 'Are'),
        ],
        string='Satuan Luas',
        default='m2',
    )
    ownership_status = fields.Selection(
        selection=[
            ('milik_sendiri', 'Milik Sendiri'),
            ('sewa', 'Sewa/Kontrak'),
            ('hibah', 'Hibah'),
            ('pinjam_pakai', 'Pinjam Pakai'),
            ('wakaf', 'Wakaf'),
            ('lainnya', 'Lainnya'),
        ],
        string='Status Kepemilikan',
        tracking=True,
    )
    certificate_type = fields.Selection(
        selection=[
            ('shm', 'SHM (Sertifikat Hak Milik)'),
            ('shgb', 'SHGB (Sertifikat Hak Guna Bangunan)'),
            ('shp', 'SHP (Sertifikat Hak Pakai)'),
            ('girik', 'Girik/Letter C'),
            ('akta_jual_beli', 'Akta Jual Beli'),
            ('belum_sertifikat', 'Belum Bersertifikat'),
            ('lainnya', 'Lainnya'),
        ],
        string='Jenis Sertifikat',
        tracking=True,
    )
    certificate_number = fields.Char(
        string='Nomor Sertifikat',
        tracking=True,
    )
    certificate_date = fields.Date(
        string='Tanggal Sertifikat',
    )
    certificate_holder = fields.Char(
        string='Atas Nama',
        help='Nama pemilik yang tercantum di sertifikat',
    )
    
    # Address Information
    address_street = fields.Char(
        string='Alamat',
    )
    address_rt = fields.Char(
        string='RT',
    )
    address_rw = fields.Char(
        string='RW',
    )
    address_village = fields.Char(
        string='Kelurahan/Desa',
    )
    address_district = fields.Char(
        string='Kecamatan',
    )
    address_city = fields.Char(
        string='Kota/Kabupaten',
    )
    address_province = fields.Char(
        string='Provinsi',
    )
    address_postal_code = fields.Char(
        string='Kode Pos',
    )
    
    # GPS Coordinates
    latitude = fields.Float(
        string='Latitude',
        digits=(16, 8),
    )
    longitude = fields.Float(
        string='Longitude',
        digits=(16, 8),
    )
    
    # active inherited from account.asset
    
    # Related fields for easy access
    klasis_id = fields.Many2one(
        related='jemaat_id.klasis_id',
        string='Klasis',
        store=True,
    )
    sinodewilayah_id = fields.Many2one(
        related='jemaat_id.sinodewilayah_id',
        string='Sinode Wilayah',
        store=True,
    )
    
    # Land Shape / Polygon Information (for land assets)
    land_shape_geojson = fields.Text(
        string='Bentuk Tanah (GeoJSON)',
        help='Data GeoJSON polygon yang menggambarkan bentuk tanah/bangunan',
    )
    land_shape_area_calculated = fields.Float(
        string='Luas Kalkulasi (m²)',
        digits=(16, 2),
        compute='_compute_land_shape_area',
        store=True,
        help='Luas tanah dalam m² dihitung dari polygon GeoJSON',
    )

    @api.depends('image', 'land_shape_geojson', 'is_land_category')
    def _compute_image_preview(self):
        """Compute preview image: use actual image if available, else generate from land shape"""
        for record in self:
            if record.image:
                record.image_preview = record.image
            elif record.land_shape_geojson and record.is_land_category:
                record.image_preview = record._generate_land_shape_image()
            else:
                record.image_preview = False

    def _generate_land_shape_image(self, width=256, height=256):
        """Generate a thumbnail image from land_shape_geojson polygon"""
        if not self.land_shape_geojson:
            return False
        
        try:
            from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
            from shapely.geometry import shape
            
            geojson = json.loads(self.land_shape_geojson)
            geometry = shape(geojson)
            
            # Get bounds of the polygon
            minx, miny, maxx, maxy = geometry.bounds
            
            # Calculate scaling to fit in image with padding
            padding = 20
            available_width = width - 2 * padding
            available_height = height - 2 * padding
            
            scale_x = available_width / (maxx - minx) if maxx != minx else 1
            scale_y = available_height / (maxy - miny) if maxy != miny else 1
            scale = min(scale_x, scale_y)
            
            # Center offset
            center_x = width / 2
            center_y = height / 2
            geo_center_x = (minx + maxx) / 2
            geo_center_y = (miny + maxy) / 2
            
            # Create image with light background
            img = Image.new('RGBA', (width, height), (248, 250, 252, 255))
            draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
            
            # Transform coordinates function
            def transform_coords(x, y):
                tx = center_x + (x - geo_center_x) * scale
                ty = center_y - (y - geo_center_y) * scale  # Flip Y axis
                return (tx, ty)
            
            # Draw the polygon
            if geometry.geom_type == 'Polygon':
                coords = list(geometry.exterior.coords)
                transformed = [transform_coords(x, y) for x, y in coords]
                # Fill with semi-transparent green
                draw.polygon(transformed, fill=(139, 195, 74, 180), outline=(67, 160, 71, 255))
                # Draw outline thicker
                draw.line(transformed + [transformed[0]], fill=(67, 160, 71, 255), width=2)
            elif geometry.geom_type == 'MultiPolygon':
                for poly in geometry.geoms:
                    coords = list(poly.exterior.coords)
                    transformed = [transform_coords(x, y) for x, y in coords]
                    draw.polygon(transformed, fill=(139, 195, 74, 180), outline=(67, 160, 71, 255))
                    draw.line(transformed + [transformed[0]], fill=(67, 160, 71, 255), width=2)
            
            # Save to bytes
            buffer = io.BytesIO()
            img.save(buffer, format='PNG')
            buffer.seek(0)
            
            return base64.b64encode(buffer.read())
            
        except Exception:
            return False

    @api.depends('land_shape_geojson')
    def _compute_land_shape_area(self):
        """Calculate area from GeoJSON polygon using Shapely"""
        for record in self:
            if record.land_shape_geojson:
                try:
                    from shapely.geometry import shape
                    from shapely.ops import transform
                    import pyproj
                    
                    geojson = json.loads(record.land_shape_geojson)
                    geometry = shape(geojson)
                    
                    # Transform from WGS84 (lat/lng) to Web Mercator for accurate area calculation
                    project = pyproj.Transformer.from_crs(
                        'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy=True
                    ).transform
                    projected = transform(project, geometry)
                    record.land_shape_area_calculated = projected.area
                except Exception:
                    record.land_shape_area_calculated = 0.0
            else:
                record.land_shape_area_calculated = 0.0

    @api.depends('date_start')
    def _compute_acquisition_year(self):
        for asset in self:
            if asset.date_start and not asset.acquisition_year:
                asset.acquisition_year = str(asset.date_start.year)
            elif not asset.date_start and not asset.acquisition_year:
                asset.acquisition_year = False

    def create(self, vals_list):

            if vals.get('code', 'New') == 'New':
                # Use sudo() to bypass ir.sequence access rights

        return super().create(vals_list)

    def name_get(self):

        for record in self:
            if record.code and record.code != 'New':
                name = f'[{record.code}] {record.name}'
            else:
                name = record.name
            result.append((record.id, name))
        return result

    @api.model
    def _name_search(self, name, args=None, operator='ilike', limit=100, name_get_uid=None):

        domain = []

Use GitHub-style alerts strategically to emphasize critical information. They will display with distinct colors and icons. Do not place consecutively or nest within other elements:

  > [!WARNING]

## Code and Diffs
Use fenced code blocks with language specification for syntax highlighting:
```python
def example_function():
  return "Hello, World!"
```

Use diff blocks to show code changes. Prefix lines with + for additions, - for deletions, and a space for unchanged lines:
```diff
-old_function_name()
+new_function_name()
 unchanged_line()
```

Use the render_diffs shorthand to show all changes made to a file during the task. Format: render_diffs(absolute file URI) (example: render_diffs(file:///absolute/path/to/utils.py)). Place on its own line.

To prevent syntax errors:

## Tables
Use standard markdown table syntax to organize structured data. Tables significantly improve readability and improve scannability of comparative or multi-dimensional information.

- Create clickable file links using standard markdown link syntax: [link text](file:///absolute/path/to/file).

412: /* ─── Floating Scroll Buttons ─── */
413: function ScrollButtons() {
414:     const [showTop, setShowTop] = useState(false);
415:     const [showBottom, setShowBottom] = useState(false);
416: 
417:     const checkScroll = useCallback(() => {
418:         const scrollY = window.scrollY;
419:         const docH = document.documentElement.scrollHeight;
420:         const winH = window.innerHeight;
421:         setShowTop(scrollY > 300);
422:         setShowBottom(scrollY + winH < docH - 200);
423:     }, []);
424: 
425:     useEffect(() => {
426:         checkScroll();
427:         window.addEventListener('scroll', checkScroll, { passive: true });
428:         window.addEventListener('resize', checkScroll, { passive: true });
429:         return () => {
430:             window.removeEventListener('scroll', checkScroll);
431:             window.removeEventListener('resize', checkScroll);
432:         };
433:     }, [checkScroll]);
434: 
435:     const scrollTo = (pos: 'top' | 'bottom') => {
436:         window.scrollTo({ top: pos === 'top' ? 0 : document.documentElement.scrollHeight, behavior: 'smooth' });
437:     };
438: 
439:     if (!showTop && !showBottom) return null;
440: 
441:     return (
442:         <div className="fixed bottom-6 right-6 flex flex-col gap-2 z-40">
443:             {showTop && (
444:                 <button
445:                     onClick={() => scrollTo('top')}
446:                     className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-gki-gray-700 shadow-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gki-gray-600 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gki-gray-600 hover:text-gki-blue transition-all hover:scale-110"
447:                     title="Ke atas"
448:                 >
449:                     <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M5 15l7-7 7 7" /></svg>
450:                 </button>
451:             )}
452:             {showBottom && (
453:                 <button
454:                     onClick={() => scrollTo('bottom')}
455:                     className="w-9 h-9 rounded-full bg-white dark:bg-gki-gray-700 shadow-lg border border-gray-200 dark:border-gki-gray-600 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-300 hover:bg-gray-50 dark:hover:bg-gki-gray-600 hover:text-gki-blue transition-all hover:scale-110"
456:                     title="Ke bawah"
457:                 >
458:                     <svg className="w-4 h-4" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" strokeWidth={2} d="M19 9l-7 7-7-7" /></svg>
459:                 </button>
460:             )}
461:         </div>
462:     );
463: }

{"CodeContent":"# 🏗️ Arsitektur Sistem GKI.ONE

## 1. Gambaran Umum

GKI.ONE adalah **Unified Church Portal** — platform terpadu untuk gereja GKI yang menggunakan arsitektur **Decoupled Headless** dengan backend Odoo 16 dan frontend Next.js.

```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                    PENGGUNA                           │
│  Jemaat (User) │ Majelis (Power User) │ Admin Sinode │
└──────┬───────────────┬──────────────────┬────────────┘
       │               │                  │
       ▼               ▼                  ▼
┌──────────────┐ ┌───────────┐  ┌──────────────────┐
│  GKI Mobile  │ │  GKI.ONE  │  │  Lumina Desktop  │
│  (Flutter)   │ │ (Next.js) │  │   (Flutter)      │
│  iOS/Android │ │   PWA     │  │ Win/Mac/Linux    │
└──────┬───────┘ └─────┬─────┘  └───────┬──────────┘
       │               │                │
       ▼               ▼                ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│              API Layer (JSON-RPC / REST)              │
│         odoo-api-16 (Python FastAPI bridge)           │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│           Odoo 16 Community Edition                   │
│      48 Custom Modules (odoo-addons-16)               │
│                                                       │
│  ┌─────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ ┌──────────┐ │
│  │  Base    │ │   HR     │ │ Finance  │ │Evaluation│ │
│  │ Modules  │ │ Modules  │ │ Modules  │ │ Modules  │ │
│  └─────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────┘ └──────────┘ │
└──────────────────────┬───────────────────────────────┘
                       │
                       ▼
              ┌─────────────────┐
              │  PostgreSQL 15  │
              └─────────────────┘
```

## 2. Tech Stack

| Layer | Teknologi | Versi |
|-------|-----------|-------|
| **Backend** | Odoo Community | 16.0 |
| **Runtime** | Python | 3.10+ |
| **Database** | PostgreSQL | 15 |
| **API** | JSON-RPC / REST | Odoo standard controllers |
| **Frontend Web** | Next.js (App Router) | 14.2+ |
| **UI Framework** | React | 18+ |
| **Language** | TypeScript | 5.0+ |
| **Styling** | Tailwind CSS | 3.4 |
| **Charts** | Recharts | 3.7 |
| **Maps** | Leaflet + React-Leaflet | 1.9 / 4.2 |
| **Rich Text** | React Quill | 2.0 |
| **PDF Export** | jsPDF + html2canvas-pro | 4.2 / 2.0 |
| **Spreadsheet** | SheetJS (xlsx) | 0.18 |
| **Desktop App** | Flutter | Latest |
| **Mobile App** | Flutter | Latest |
| **Music Server** | Navidrome | - |

## 3. Struktur Repositori

```
church-management-system/
├── gki-one/                    # 🌐 Frontend Next.js (Portal Jemaat)
├── gki-mobile/                 # 📱 Mobile App Flutter (iOS/Android)
├── lumina/                     # 🖥️ Desktop App Flutter (Operator Ibadah)
├── odoo-addons-16/             # ⚙️ 48 Modul Odoo 16 (Backend Core)
├── odoo-api-16/                # 🔌 API Layer (Python FastAPI)
├── odoo-addons/                # 📦 Legacy Modules (Odoo 8/10)
├── device-auth/                # 📺 TV & Smart Device Auth
├── server-side-upload/         # 📤 File Upload Utility
├── web-account-management/     # 👤 Account Management Web
├── wordpress-tools/            # 🔧 WP Migration Tools
├── sonicvault/                 # 🔊 Audio Processing
├── assets/                     # 🖼️ Shared Assets
└── docs/                       # 📚 Dokumentasi (folder ini)
```

## 4. Hierarki Organisasi Gereja

Sistem mengikuti struktur organisasi GKI:

```
Sinode (Nasional)
  └── Sinode Wilayah (Regional)
        └── Klasis (Sub-regional)
              └── Jemaat (Kongregasi/Gereja Lokal)
                    └── Anggota (Member/Jemaat)
```

Setiap level memiliki dashboard, profil, dan pengukuran evaluasi masing-masing.

## 5. Authentication Flow

```
User Login → GKI.ONE (Next.js)
         ↓
    /api/auth → JSON-RPC → Odoo Session Auth
         ↓
    Session Cookie + Role Detection
         ↓
    /api/user/roles → Menu Visibility (RBAC)
         ↓
    Conditional Navigation Rendering
```

### Metode Autentikasi:
- **Password** — Login standar Odoo
- **Passkey (WebAuthn)** — Passwordless login
- **Device Auth (RFC 8628)** — OAuth 2.0 Device Flow untuk TV/Smart Display
- **Auth Bridge** — Cross-authenticate dari CMS Odoo 12 ke RKA Odoo 16

## 6. Dependency Graph Modul Utama

```mermaid
graph TD
    CB[church_base] --> CMB[church_management_base]
    CB --> CHR[church_hr]
    CB --> CE[church_evaluation]
    CB --> CP[church_program]
    CB --> CD[church_dashboard]
    
    CMB --> CRP[church_crm]
    CMB --> CBUR[church_management_bursapelayanan]
    CMB --> CPRE[church_management_presensi]
    CMB --> CKM[church_management_komisi_member]
    CMB --> CIM[church_immich]
    CMB --> CDA[church_device_auth]
    
    CE --> CPE[church_program_evaluation]
    CE --> CDB[church_dashboard_builder]
    CE --> CDSH[church_dashboard]
    
    CP --> CPE
    CP --> CF[church_forms]
    
    CHR --> CAS[church_asset]
    
    CB --> CEL[church_elearning]
    CB --> CPOR[church_portal]
```

{"CodeContent":"# ⚙️ Katalog Modul Backend Odoo 16

Daftar lengkap 48 modul custom Odoo 16 yang membentuk backend GKI.ONE.

---

## A. Modul Inti (Core)

### 1. `church_base` — Church Base
- **Versi**: 16.0.1.0.0
- **Deskripsi**: Modul fondasi yang mendefinisikan model organisasi gereja
- **Fitur**:
  - Model hierarki: Sinode → Sinode Wilayah → Klasis → Jemaat
  - Seed data organisasi (data sinode, SW, klasis, jemaat)
  - Leaflet map integration (GeoEngine)
  - Security groups (CMS roles)
  - SIM GKI Dashboard (OWL backend)
  - Bidang & Komisi master data
  - User management extensions
  - Portal templates

{"CodeContent":"# 🌐 Portal GKI.ONE — Frontend Features

Portal web GKI.ONE dibangun dengan **Next.js 14 (App Router)** + TypeScript + TailwindCSS.

---

## Navigasi Utama (Sidebar)

| Menu | Sub-Menu | Access Control | Route |
|------|----------|---------------|-------|
| **Beranda** | — | `always` | `/` |
| **Dashboard** | Dashboard Saya | `dashboard` | `/my-dashboard` |
| | Profil Saya | `myprofile` | `/my-profile` |
| **Direktori** | Direktori Pelayan | `always` | `/pelayan` |
| | Direktori Jemaat | `always` | `/direktori/jemaat` |
| **Jemaat** | Profil Jemaat | `profile` | `/jemaat/profile` |
| | Potret Jemaat (PURJ) | `purj` | `/purj` |
| | Monitoring PURJ | `purj` | `/purj/monitoring` |
| | Keuangan | `finance` | `/finance` |
| | Aset | `asset` | `/assets` |
| **Klasis** | Dashboard Klasis | `kelola_klasis` | `/klasis/dashboard` |
| | Profil Klasis | `kelola_klasis` | `/klasis/profile` |
| | Potret Klasis | `kelola_klasis` | `/klasis/purj` |
| | Monitoring PURJ | `kelola_klasis` | `/klasis/purj/monitoring` |
| **Sinode Wilayah** | Dashboard SW | `kelola_sinodewilayah` | `/sinodewilayah/dashboard` |
| | Profil SW | `kelola_sinodewilayah` | `/sinodewilayah/profile` |
| | Potret SW | `kelola_sinodewilayah` | `/sinodewilayah/purj` |
| | Monitoring PURJ | `kelola_sinodewilayah` | `/sinodewilayah/purj/monitoring` |
| | Laporan | `kelola_sinodewilayah` | `/sinodewilayah/evaluation-report` |
| **Sinode** | Dashboard Sinode | `kelola_sinode` | `/sinode/dashboard` |

{"CodeContent":"# 👤 Manajemen SDM Gereja

Detail fitur pengelolaan Sumber Daya Manusia gereja pada GKI.ONE.

---

## 1. Overview

Modul SDM mengelola seluruh siklus hidup pelayan gereja — mulai dari biodata profil hingga penugasan dan evaluasi. Terdiri dari backend Odoo (`church_hr`, `church_management_base`) dan frontend portal (`/sdm`).

---

## 2. Biodata & Profil Lengkap

### 2.1 Data Pribadi (dari `church_management_base`)
- **Identitas**: Nama lengkap, nama panggilan, gelar
- **Kontak**: Email, telepon, handphone, alamat
- **Demografis**: Tanggal lahir, jenis kelamin, status pernikahan, golongan darah
- **Keagamaan**: Tanggal baptis, tanggal sidi, tanggal atestasi
- **Foto**: Upload foto profil dengan image resize
- **Geolocation**: Koordinat GPS alamat (base_geolocalize)
- **Google Maps**: Integrasi profil Google Maps (rating, reviews)

### 2.2 Data Kependudukan (dari `isf_partner`)
- **Alamat Indonesia**: Provinsi, Kota/Kabupaten, Kecamatan, Kelurahan
- **KTP/NIK**: Nomor identitas penduduk
- **Kode Pos**: Auto-complete berdasarkan wilayah

### 2.3 Riwayat Pendidikan
- Jenjang pendidikan (SD – S3)
- Nama institusi
- Bidang studi
- Tahun masuk & lulus

### 2.4 Riwayat Pekerjaan
- Nama perusahaan/instansi
- Jabatan
- Bidang pekerjaan
- Periode kerja

### 2.5 Relasi Keluarga
- Tipe relasi (suami/istri, anak, orangtua, dll)
- Linking antar anggota jemaat
- Family tree view

### 2.6 Hobi & Minat
- Daftar hobi dari master data
- Skill & interest tags

---

## 3. Pendeta & Pelayan (dari `church_hr`)

### 3.1 Data Pendeta
- **Jabatan Gereja**: Pendeta, Vikaris, Calon Pendeta, Emeritus
- **Penugasan**: Jemaat penugasan saat ini

- **CV/Resume**: Generate PDF report otomatis
- **Profil Publik**: Halaman `/pendeta/[id]` yang bisa diakses publik

### 3.2 Skill & Interest Database
- Kompetensi teologi
- Kemampuan bahasa
- Keahlian khusus (musik, konseling, dll)

### 3.3 Relasi Keluarga Pendeta
- Data keluarga khusus pendeta
- Tipe relasi yang diperluas

---

## 4. Frontend Portal SDM (`/sdm`)

  - Biodata
  - Pendidikan
  - Pekerjaan
  - Keluarga
  - Penugasan

### 4.3 Struktur Organisasi (`/sdm/structure/page.tsx`)

## 5. Keanggotaan Komisi (`church_management_komisi_member`)

### 5.1 Workflow Keanggotaan
```
Draft → Pending → Active → Alumni
```

### 5.2 Metode Pendaftaran
- **Invite**: Admin mengundang anggota
- **Self-Enroll**: Anggota mendaftar sendiri
- **Admin Wizard**: Batch enrollment

### 5.3 Change Request
- Anggota mengajukan perubahan data
- Admin meng-approve/reject
- Audit trail perubahan

### 5.4 Batch Operations
- **Batch Enrollment Wizard**: Daftarkan banyak anggota sekaligus
- **Batch Graduation Wizard**: Keluluskan banyak anggota sekaligus

### 5.5 Field Visibility
- Konfigurasi field mana yang visible per komisi
- Kontrol akses data granular

## 6. Jalur Pelayanan (`church_management_bursapelayanan`)

### 6.1 Bursa Pelayanan
- Publikasi kebutuhan pelayanan (lowongan)

- Matching antara kebutuhan dan ketersediaan

### 6.3 Tracking Pelayanan

- Status pelayanan aktif

### 7.2 Direktori Jemaat (`/direktori/jemaat`)
- Daftar jemaat (kongregasi)
- Informasi dasar setiap jemaat

### 7.3 Profil Publik Pendeta (`/pendeta/[id]`)
- Halaman publik tanpa login

- **Self-Service Profile**: Anggota bisa melihat dan mengupdate profil sendiri
- **Data Update Request**: Pengajuan perubahan data yang perlu approval

- **Passkey Management**: Kelola kredensial WebAuthn

{"CodeContent":"# 🏛️ Portal Terpadu Jemaat

Detail fitur portal untuk level **Jemaat** (kongregasi gereja lokal).

---

## 1. Overview

Setiap jemaat (kongregasi) memiliki akses ke portal terpadu yang mencakup:
- Profil jemaat
- Dashboard pengukuran (PURJ)
- Keuangan
- Manajemen aset
- eLearning
- Forum diskusi
- Messaging

---

## 2. Profil Jemaat (`/jemaat/profile`)

### 2.1 Informasi Dasar
- Nama jemaat, alamat, kontak
- Logo dan foto gereja
- Koordinat GPS & peta lokasi
- Sinode Wilayah & Klasis induk
- Google Maps profile data (rating, reviews, status)

### 2.2 Visi & Misi
- Visi jemaat
- Misi jemaat
- Public page visi/misi (Odoo website)

### 2.3 Sejarah & Identitas
- Tahun berdiri
- Nomor SK
- Informasi historis

---

## 3. Potret Umum Realisasi Jemaat — PURJ (`/purj`)

### 3.1 Apa itu PURJ?
PURJ adalah **sistem pengukuran kinerja** jemaat berdasarkan indikator-indikator (measures) yang telah ditentukan. Setiap jemaat mengisi data pengukuran per tahun fiskal.

### 3.2 Measures (Indikator Pengukuran)
Indikator dibagi ke dalam beberapa kategori:
- **SDM**: Jumlah pendeta, vikaris, staff, majelis
- **Ibadah**: Jumlah ibadah, rata-rata kehadiran, jumlah baptisan, sidi
- **Kesaksian & Pelayanan**: Program pelayanan masyarakat
- **Persekutuan**: Kelompok komunitas, PA, dll
- **Keuangan**: Pendapatan, pengeluaran, aset
- **Keunggulan & Kelemahan**: Analisis SWOT naratif

### 3.3 Fitur PURJ Portal
- **Multi-tab interface**: SDM, Ibadah, Kesaksian, Keuangan, dll
- **Per-tahun fiskal**: Dropdown filter tahun
- **Input values**: Edit langsung dari portal
- **JSON Table Widget**: Tabel data terstruktur (misal: daftar pendeta)
- **Sync to PURJ Dialog**: Sinkronisasi data dari modul lain ke measures
- **PDF/CSV Export**: Download laporan

### 3.4 Monitoring PURJ (`/purj/monitoring`)
- **Dashboard monitoring**: Grafik progress pengisian PURJ
- **PurjMonitoringDashboard component**: Real-time tracking
- **Recharts visualizations**: Bar, line, pie charts
- **Year filter toggle**: Perbandingan antar tahun

---

## 4. Keuangan (`/finance`)

### 4.1 Ringkasan Keuangan
- **Total pendapatan & pengeluaran**
- **Saldo kas/bank**
- **Grafik trend keuangan** (line chart)
- **Periode filter**: Per bulan, per tahun

### 4.2 Pembayaran (`/finance/payment`)
- Riwayat pembayaran/transaksi
- Detail invoice

### 4.3 Bank Statement
- Import bank statement (CSV/PDF/HTML)
- Dynamic import scripts
- Tagging transaksi
- Approval workflow

### 4.4 Integrasi Akuntansi Odoo
- Chart of Account
- Journal entries
- Fiscal year management
- Budget reference per komisi

---

## 5. Manajemen Aset (`/assets`)

### 5.1 Daftar Aset
- Inventaris lengkap per jemaat
- Kategorisasi: Gedung, Tanah, Kendaraan, Peralatan Ibadah, Elektronik, Furniture
- Pencarian & filter

### 5.2 Detail Aset
- Foto aset
- Kondisi aset (baik/rusak ringan/rusak berat)
- Status (aktif/tidak aktif/disposal)
- Nilai aset & depresiasi
- Lokasi ruangan

### 5.3 Peta Bidang Tanah
- **LandShapeEditor**: Editor polygon interaktif (Leaflet Draw)
- Geo-computation luas tanah (shapely + pyproj)
- Overlay peta satelit

### 5.4 Manajemen Ruangan
- Daftar ruangan & fasilitas
- Reservasi/peminjaman dengan approval
- Calendar view jadwal pemakaian
- Tracking aset per ruangan

---

## 6. Dashboard Jemaat (`/dashboard`)

### 6.1 Custom Dashboard
- **DashboardGrid**: Drag & drop widget layout (React Grid Layout)
- **WidgetSelector**: Pilih dari berbagai tipe widget
- **WidgetEditor**: Konfigurasi setiap widget

### 6.2 Tipe Widget
| Widget | Deskripsi |
|--------|-----------|
| **StatWidget** | Angka KPI (total jemaat, pendapatan, dll) |
| **BarChartWidget** | Perbandingan kategori |
| **LineChartWidget** | Trend waktu |
| **PieChartWidget** | Distribusi/komposisi |
| **TrendChartWidget** | Analisis trend multi-series |

### 6.3 Data Source
- Measure values dari PURJ
- Financial data dari akuntansi
- Aggregasi server-side (Odoo read_group)
- Chart colors palette terstandar

---

## 7. eLearning (`/elearning`)

### 7.1 Daftar Kursus
- Browse kursus yang tersedia
- Kategori kursus
- Preview konten

### 7.2 Konten Pembelajaran
- Slides (presentasi)
- Video embedded
- Dokumen PDF
- Quiz (dari Odoo website_slides)

### 7.3 Progress Tracking
- Status penyelesaian per kursus
- Sertifikat kelulusan

---

## 8. Forum Diskusi (`/forum`)

### 8.1 Fitur Forum
- Daftar forum/topik
- Buat posting baru (`/forum/post`)
- Detail forum & replies (`/forum/[forumId]`)
- Kategori diskusi
- Karma system

### 8.2 Interaksi
- Upvote/downvote
- Reply threading
- Rich text editor (React Quill)

---

## 9. Pesan / Messaging (`/messages`)

### 9.1 Internal Messaging
- Channels/grup pesan (`/messages/[channelId]`)
- Direct messages
- Real-time polling (60s interval)
- Notification bell (unread count)

---

## 10. Fitur Tambahan

### 10.1 My Dashboard (`/my-dashboard`)
- Dashboard personal user
- Customizable layout

### 10.2 My Profile (`/my-profile`)
- Self-service profile view/edit
- Data update request

### 10.3 Settings (`/settings`)
- Pengaturan akun
- Passkey management
- Theme (dark/light)

### 10.4 Onboarding (`/onboarding`)
- Guided tour untuk pengguna baru
- Step-by-step profile completion
- Skip option (session-based)

{"CodeContent":"# 📊 Klasis & Sinode Wilayah — Dashboard Analisis & Charting Intelligence

Detail fitur dashboard analisis, charting, dan laporan evaluasi untuk level Klasis dan Sinode Wilayah.

---

## 1. Hierarki & Akses

```
Sinode (Nasional) ─────────── kelola_sinode
   └── Sinode Wilayah ──────── kelola_sinodewilayah / litbang_sinodewilayah
         └── Klasis ─────────── kelola_klasis / litbang_klasis
               └── Jemaat ────── profile / purj / finance
```

Setiap level mewarisi visibilitas data dari level di bawahnya. Misalnya:
- **Klasis** melihat semua data jemaat di bawahnya
- **Sinode Wilayah** melihat semua klasis & jemaat di bawahnya
- **Litbang** memiliki akses read-only untuk keperluan penelitian

---

## 2. Dashboard Klasis (`/klasis/dashboard`)

### 2.1 Komponen Dashboard Klasis

| Komponen | File | Ukuran | Deskripsi |
|----------|------|--------|-----------|
| **Page utama** | `page.tsx` | 40 KB | Container dashboard utama |
| **SDM Charts** | `KlasisSDMCharts.tsx` | 90 KB | Visualisasi data SDM komprehensif |
| **Ibadah Charts** | `KlasisIbadahCharts.tsx` | 39 KB | Analisis kehadiran & ibadah |
| **Keuangan Charts** | `KlasisKeuanganCharts.tsx` | 29 KB | Analisis keuangan antar jemaat |
| **Kesaksian Charts** | `KlasisKesaksianCharts.tsx` | 19 KB | Visualisasi data kesaksian & pelayanan |
| **Keunggulan Charts** | `KlasisKeunggulanCharts.tsx` | 13 KB | Analisis keunggulan & kelemahan |
| **Analisis Chart** | `KlasisAnalisisChart.tsx` | 18 KB | Chart analisis komparatif |
| **Jemaat Map** | `KlasisJemaatMap.tsx` | 11 KB | Peta distribusi jemaat dalam klasis |
| **Narrative Block** | `NarrativeBlock.tsx` | 2.5 KB | Blok narasi evaluasi |
| **PDF Export** | `KlasisPdfExport.tsx` | 25 KB | Ekspor dashboard ke PDF |

### 2.2 Fitur SDM Charts (90 KB — komponen terbesar)
- **Distribusi Jabatan**: Bar chart pendeta, vikaris, calon pendeta per jemaat
- **Rasio Pendeta/Jemaat**: KPI ratio analysis
- **Komposisi Gender**: Pie chart komposisi SDM
- **Trend SDM**: Line chart trend jumlah SDM per tahun
- **Tabel Detail**: Breakdown per jemaat

### 2.3 Fitur Ibadah Charts
- **Rata-rata Kehadiran**: Perbandingan antar jemaat
- **Jumlah Ibadah**: Bar chart frekuensi ibadah
- **Baptisan & Sidi**: Trend tahunan
- **Komparasi Year-over-Year**: Perbandingan antar tahun fiskal

### 2.4 Fitur Keuangan Charts
- **Total Pendapatan**: Stacked bar antar jemaat
- **Pengeluaran per Kategori**: Pie chart distribusi
- **Ratio Pendapatan/Pengeluaran**: KPI gauge
- **Trend Keuangan**: Line chart multi-year

### 2.5 Fitur Kesaksian Charts
- **Program Pelayanan Masyarakat**: Bar chart per jemaat
- **Kelompok PA/Komunitas**: Distribusi
- **Outreach Activities**: Tracking kegiatan keluar

### 2.6 Fitur Keunggulan/Kelemahan
- **Analisis SWOT**: Visualisasi narasi keunggulan dan kelemahan
- **Word Cloud / Tag Cloud**: Tema yang sering muncul
- **Komparatif**: Perbandingan antar jemaat

### 2.7 Peta Jemaat (KlasisJemaatMap)
- **Leaflet Map**: Peta interaktif dengan markers
- **Cluster Markers**: Pengelompokan jemaat yang berdekatan
- **Info Popup**: Detail jemaat saat klik marker
- **Geo-analysis**: Distribusi geografis

### 2.8 Ekspor PDF
- **Full Dashboard to PDF**: html2canvas + jsPDF
- **Multi-page**: Setiap section sebagai halaman terpisah
- **Branding**: Header GKI, tanggal cetak, watermark

---

## 3. Dashboard Sinode Wilayah (`/sinodewilayah/dashboard`)

### 3.1 Komponen Dashboard Sinode Wilayah

| Komponen | File | Ukuran | Deskripsi |
|----------|------|--------|-----------|
| **Page utama** | `page.tsx` | 16 KB | Container dashboard SW |
| **SDM Charts** | `SWSDMCharts.tsx` | 34 KB | Visualisasi SDM agregat per klasis |
| **Ibadah Charts** | `SWIbadahCharts.tsx` | 11 KB | Analisis ibadah agregat |
| **Keuangan Charts** | `SWKeuanganCharts.tsx` | 13 KB | Keuangan agregat per klasis |
| **Drilldown Chart** | `SWDrilldownChart.tsx` | 30 KB | Chart interaktif drill-down |
| **Heat Map** | `SWHeatMap.tsx` | 15 KB | Heat map performa jemaat |
| **Jemaat Map** | `SWJemaatMap.tsx` | 8 KB | Peta semua jemaat di SW |

### 3.2 Drilldown Chart (Intelligence Feature — 30 KB)
- **Level 1**: Overview semua klasis dalam SW
- **Level 2**: Klik klasis → breakdown per jemaat
- **Level 3**: Klik jemaat → detail measures
- **Interaktif**: Breadcrumb navigation, zoom in/out
- **Multi-metric**: Pilih indikator yang ingin di-drill

### 3.3 Heat Map (Intelligence Feature — 15 KB)
- **Grid View**: Jemaat × Indikator
- **Color Coding**: Merah (rendah) → Kuning → Hijau (tinggi)
- **Normalisasi**: Skala relatif terhadap rata-rata
- **Hover Detail**: Tooltip dengan nilai detail
- **Sorting**: Sort berdasarkan performa keseluruhan

### 3.4 Map Analysis (`/sinodewilayah/map-analysis`)
- **MapAnalysisClient**: Komponen analisis peta interaktif (26 KB)
- **Geo-fencing**: Visualisasi batas wilayah
- **Density Analysis**: Kepadatan jemaat per area
- **Filter**: Filter berdasarkan klasis, status, ukuran

---

## 4. Potret (PURJ) Level Klasis & SW

### 4.1 Potret Klasis (`/klasis/purj`)
- **Agregasi**: Data PURJ dari semua jemaat dalam klasis
- **Perbandingan**: Tabel perbandingan antar jemaat
- **Multi-year**: Filter tahun fiskal
- **Monitoring**: Status pengisian per jemaat
- **Narrative**: Evaluasi naratif klasis (dari Odoo backend)

### 4.2 Potret Sinode Wilayah (`/sinodewilayah/purj`)
- **Agregasi**: Data dari semua klasis dalam SW
- **Perbandingan**: Tabel perbandingan antar klasis
- **Monitoring**: Progress pengisian per klasis/jemaat

### 4.3 Monitoring PURJ
- **Klasis** (`/klasis/purj/monitoring`): Tracking pengisian jemaat
- **Sinode Wilayah** (`/sinodewilayah/purj/monitoring`): Tracking pengisian klasis

---

## 5. Laporan Evaluasi (`/sinodewilayah/evaluation-report`)

### 5.1 Fitur Laporan (45 KB page)
- **Comprehensive Report**: Laporan evaluasi lengkap SW
- **Section-based**: Evaluasi per section (SDM, Ibadah, Keuangan, dll)
- **Narasi**: Blok narasi dengan rich text
- **Tabel Data**: Summary tables per indikator
- **Chart Embedded**: Grafik dalam laporan
- **PDF Export**: Download laporan lengkap

### 5.2 Evaluation Section (Odoo Backend)
- `sw_evaluation_views.xml`: Formulir evaluasi SW
- `sw_evaluation_section_views.xml`: Section detail

{"CodeContent":"# 🔐 Keamanan & Autentikasi

Sistem keamanan multi-layer GKI.ONE.

---

## 1. Metode Autentikasi

### 1.1 Password Login (Standard)
- Odoo session authentication via JSON-RPC
- Session cookie management
- Next.js middleware route protection

### 1.2 Passkey / WebAuthn (`auth_passkey`)
- Passwordless login menggunakan biometrik (fingerprint, face ID)
- FIDO2 standard
- Komponen: `PasskeyLoginButton`, `PasskeyManager`, `PasskeyRecommendationBanner`
- Multi-device support

### 1.3 Device Auth — RFC 8628 (`church_device_auth`)
- Untuk TV & Smart Display tanpa keyboard
- 6-digit pairing code + QR code
- OAuth 2.0 Device Authorization Grant
- Auto-cleanup expired codes (cron)
- Support: Android TV, Apple TV, Fire TV

### 1.4 Auth Bridge (`church_auth_bridge`)
- Cross-system authentication: CMS (Odoo 12) ↔ RKA (Odoo 16)
- Auto-create local user jika belum ada
- Password sync setelah remote auth berhasil
- Configurable via System Parameters

### 1.5 Brute Force Protection (`auth_brute_force`)
- Tracking failed login per IP & username
- Auto-block setelah threshold

---

## 2. Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

### 2.1 User Roles (Frontend Detection)
```typescript
interface UserAccess {
    dashboard: boolean;           // Dashboard Saya
    profile: boolean;             // Profil Jemaat
    purj: boolean;                // PURJ (Potret)
    finance: boolean;             // Keuangan
    asset: boolean;               // Aset
    elearning: boolean;           // eLearning
    myprofile: boolean;           // Profil Saya
    sdm_gereja: boolean;          // SDM Gereja
    anggota: boolean;             // Anggota
    analitik: boolean;            // Analitik
    forum: boolean;               // Forum
    messages: boolean;            // Pesan
    kelola_klasis: boolean;       // Admin Klasis
    kelola_sinodewilayah: boolean; // Admin Sinode Wilayah
    kelola_sinode: boolean;       // Admin Sinode
    litbang_klasis: boolean;      // Litbang Klasis (read-only)
    litbang_sinodewilayah: boolean; // Litbang SW (read-only)
    litbang_sinode: boolean;      // Litbang Sinode (read-only)
}
```

### 2.2 Odoo Security Groups
- **CMS Groups** (`church_base`): Base security groups
- **Pendeta Security** (`church_hr`): SDM access
- **Program Security** (`church_program`): RKA access
- **Evaluation Security** (`church_evaluation`): PURJ access
- **Litbang Security** (`church_evaluation`): Research access
- **Dashboard Security** (`church_dashboard_builder`): Dashboard access
- **Pastoral Visit Groups** (`church_crm`): CRM access
- **Asset Security** (`church_asset`): Asset per jemaat
- **Room Security** (`church_room`): Room management
- **Portal Security** (`church_portal`): Portal user filtering

### 2.3 Litbang Hierarchy
Litbang (Penelitian & Pengembangan) memiliki akses read-only berjenjang:
- **Litbang Klasis**: Akses data evaluasi jemaat dalam klasis
- **Litbang Sinode Wilayah**: Akses data evaluasi semua klasis dalam SW
- **Litbang Sinode**: Akses data evaluasi seluruh organisasi

### 2.4 Record Rules (ir.rule)
- Jemaat admin hanya melihat jemaat yang dikelola
- Anggota hanya melihat data dalam jemaatnya
- Klasis admin melihat semua jemaat dalam klasis
- SW admin melihat semua klasis dalam SW

---

## 3. Admin Features

### 3.1 Admin Impersonate (`admin_user_impersonate`)
- Admin bisa login sebagai user lain untuk debugging
- Audit trail impersonation

### 3.2 Login History (`church_management_base`)
- Tracking login per user
- IP address, timestamp, user agent

---

## 4. API Security

### 4.1 Rate Limiting (`rateLimit.ts`)
- Client-side rate limiting
- Prevent API abuse

### 4.2 Session Validation
- Next.js middleware validates session on every request
- Redirect to login if session expired

### 4.3 CORS
- Configured per deployment
- Whitelist allowed origins

{"CodeContent":"# 🔌 Integrasi & API

Daftar integrasi pihak ketiga dan API layer GKI.ONE.

---

## 1. API Layer (`odoo-api-16`)

### 1.1 Arsitektur
- **Framework**: Python FastAPI
- **Entry point**: `src/main.py` → `src/app.py`
- **Fungsi**: Bridge antara Next.js frontend dan Odoo backend
- **Protokol**: JSON-RPC + REST

### 1.2 Odoo JSON-RPC Endpoints
Frontend berkomunikasi dengan Odoo melalui proxy Next.js API routes:
- `/web/session/authenticate` — Login
- `/web/session/destroy` — Logout
- `/web/dataset/call_kw` — Model method calls
- `/web/dataset/search_read` — Data queries

---

## 2. Integrasi Pihak Ketiga

### 2.1 Immich Photo Gallery (`church_immich`)
- **Fungsi**: Sinkronisasi foto dan face matching
- **API**: Immich REST API
- **Fitur**:
  - Sync People data dari Immich
  - Face matching anggota jemaat
  - Display foto terkait
  - Cron job otomatis

### 2.2 Navidrome Music Server (`church_management_navidrome`)
- **Fungsi**: Streaming audio lagu gereja
- **API**: Navidrome/Subsonic API
- **Fitur**: Database lagu terintegrasi

### 2.3 Google Maps
- **Fungsi**: Profil bisnis gereja di Google
- **Data**: Rating, reviews, status operasional
- **Field**: `googlemap_data` JSON di model jemaat

### 2.4 Leaflet Maps
- **Fungsi**: Peta interaktif di frontend
- **Library**: Leaflet + React-Leaflet + Leaflet Draw
- **Fitur**: Markers, clusters, polygon editor, satellite view

### 2.5 SMS Gateway (`sms_gateway_client`)
- **Fungsi**: Kirim SMS notifikasi
- **Library**: Jinja2 templating
- **Fitur**: Compose wizard, tracking, server actions

### 2.6 Telegram Integration
- **Fungsi**: Pengingat kunjungan pastoral (`church_crm`)
- **Channel**: Notification bot

### 2.7 Augmented Reality (`church_ar`)
- **Fungsi**: AR content untuk buku fisik
- **Platform**: WebAR / native AR

---

## 3. Frontend Libraries & Integrations

| Library | Versi | Fungsi |
|---------|-------|--------|
| **Recharts** | 3.7 | Charting (Bar, Line, Pie, Area, Composed) |
| **Leaflet** | 1.9 | Peta interaktif |
| **React-Leaflet** | 4.2 | React wrapper untuk Leaflet |
| **React-Leaflet-Cluster** | 4.0 | Marker clustering |
| **React-Leaflet-Draw** | 0.20 | Polygon drawing tools |
| **React Quill** | 2.0 | Rich text editor (WYSIWYG) |
| **React Grid Layout** | 2.2 | Drag & drop dashboard layout |
| **SheetJS (xlsx)** | 0.18 | Excel/CSV import-export |
| **jsPDF** | 4.2 | PDF generation |
| **jspdf-autotable** | 5.0 | PDF table generation |
| **html2canvas-pro** | 2.0 | DOM to canvas (screenshot) |
| **date-fns** | 4.1 | Date manipulation |

---

## 4. Multi-Platform Clients

### 4.1 GKI.ONE Web (`gki-one/`)
- **Tech**: Next.js 14, React 18, TypeScript, TailwindCSS
- **Mode**: PWA-ready
- **Target**: Desktop & mobile browser

### 4.2 GKI Mobile (`gki-mobile/`)
- **Tech**: Flutter (Dart)
- **Platforms**: iOS, Android, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux
- **Features**: Alkitab, calendar, events, renungan, PDF viewer
- **Auth**: Session-based + public endpoints

### 4.3 Lumina Desktop (`lumina/`)
- **Tech**: Flutter (Dart)
- **Platforms**: Windows, macOS, Linux
- **Fungsi**: Operator ibadah (proyeksi slide, lirik, liturgi real-time)

### 4.4 Device Auth (`device-auth/`)
- **Fungsi**: Companion app untuk TV/Smart Display pairing

### 4.5 SonicVault (`sonicvault/`)
- **Fungsi**: Audio processing & music management

---

## 5. Deployment Architecture

```
Internet
    │
    ├── pfSense Firewall (GeoIP filtering)
    │
    ├── Apache Reverse Proxy (HTTPS, security headers)
    │   ├── → Odoo 16 (port 8069)
    │   ├── → GKI.ONE Next.js (port 3000)
    │   ├── → WordPress (PHP)
    │   └── → Navidrome (port 4533)
    │
    └── fail2ban (brute force protection)
```

### 5.1 Infrastructure Stack
- **Firewall**: pfSense
- **Web Server**: Apache (reverse proxy)
- **App Server**: Odoo 16 + Node.js (Next.js)
- **Database**: PostgreSQL 15
- **Music**: Navidrome
- **Photos**: Immich
- **CMS Legacy**: WordPress
- **Security**: fail2ban, GeoIP blocking

---

## 6. Data Flow

```
User Action (Browser/App)
     │
     ▼
Next.js API Route (/api/*)
     │
     ▼
Odoo JSON-RPC (server-side fetch)
     │
     ▼
Odoo ORM (search_read / call_kw)
     │
     ▼
PostgreSQL Query
     │
     ▼
Response → JSON → React State → UI Render
```

246:     def _generate_land_shape_image(self, width=256, height=256):
247:         """Generate a thumbnail image from land_shape_geojson polygon"""
248:         if not self.land_shape_geojson:
249:             return False
250:         
251:         try:
252:             from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
253:             from shapely.geometry import shape
254:             
255:             geojson = json.loads(self.land_shape_geojson)
256:             geometry = shape(geojson)
257:             
258:             # Get bounds of the polygon
259:             minx, miny, maxx, maxy = geometry.bounds
260:             
261:             # Calculate scaling to fit in image with padding
262:             padding = 20
263:             available_width = width - 2 * padding
264:             available_height = height - 2 * padding
265:             
266:             scale_x = available_width / (maxx - minx) if maxx != minx else 1
267:             scale_y = available_height / (maxy - miny) if maxy != miny else 1
268:             scale = min(scale_x, scale_y)
269:             
270:             # Center offset
271:             center_x = width / 2
272:             center_y = height / 2
273:             geo_center_x = (minx + maxx) / 2
274:             geo_center_y = (miny + maxy) / 2
275:             
276:             # Create image with light background
277:             img = Image.new('RGBA', (width, height), (248, 250, 252, 255))
278:             draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
279:             
280:             # Transform coordinates function
281:             def transform_coords(x, y):
282:                 tx = center_x + (x - geo_center_x) * scale
283:                 ty = center_y - (y - geo_center_y) * scale  # Flip Y axis
284:                 return (tx, ty)
285:             
286:             # Draw the polygon
287:             if geometry.geom_type == 'Polygon':
288:                 coords = list(geometry.exterior.coords)
289:                 transformed = [transform_coords(x, y) for x, y in coords]
290:                 # Fill with semi-transparent green
291:                 draw.polygon(transformed, fill=(139, 195, 74, 180), outline=(67, 160, 71, 255))
292:                 # Draw outline thicker
293:                 draw.line(transformed + [transformed[0]], fill=(67, 160, 71, 255), width=2)
294:             elif geometry.geom_type == 'MultiPolygon':
295:                 for poly in geometry.geoms:
296:                     coords = list(poly.exterior.coords)
297:                     transformed = [transform_coords(x, y) for x, y in coords]
298:                     draw.polygon(transformed, fill=(139, 195, 74, 180), outline=(67, 160, 71, 255))
299:                     draw.line(transformed + [transformed[0]], fill=(67, 160, 71, 255), width=2)
300:             
301:             # Save to bytes
302:             buffer = io.BytesIO()
303:             img.save(buffer, format='PNG')
304:             buffer.seek(0)
305:             
306:             return base64.b64encode(buffer.read())
307:             
308:         except Exception:
309:             return False

promptSections.content:
<web_application_development>
## Technology Stack,
Your web applications should be built using the following technologies:,
1. **Core**: Use HTML for structure and Javascript for logic.
2. **Styling (CSS)**: Use Vanilla CSS for maximum flexibility and control. Avoid using TailwindCSS unless the USER explicitly requests it; in this case, first confirm which TailwindCSS version to use.
3. **Web App**: If the USER specifies that they want a more complex web app, use a framework like Next.js or Vite. Only do this if the USER explicitly requests a web app.
4. **New Project Creation**: If you need to use a framework for a new app, use `npx` with the appropriate script, but there are some rules to follow:,
   - Use `npx -y` to automatically install the script and its dependencies
   - You MUST run the command with `--help` flag to see all available options first, 
   - Initialize the app in the current directory with `./` (example: `npx -y create-vite-app@latest ./`),
   - You should run in non-interactive mode so that the user doesn't need to input anything,
5. **Running Locally**: When running locally, use `npm run dev` or equivalent dev server. Only build the production bundle if the USER explicitly requests it or you are validating the code for correctness.

# Design Aesthetics,
1. **Use Rich Aesthetics**: The USER should be wowed at first glance by the design. Use best practices in modern web design (e.g. vibrant colors, dark modes, glassmorphism, and dynamic animations) to create a stunning first impression. Failure to do this is UNACCEPTABLE.
2. **Prioritize Visual Excellence**: Implement designs that will WOW the user and feel extremely premium:
		- Avoid generic colors (plain red, blue, green). Use curated, harmonious color palettes (e.g., HSL tailored colors, sleek dark modes).
   - Using modern typography (e.g., from Google Fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Outfit) instead of browser defaults.
		- Use smooth gradients,
		- Add subtle micro-animations for enhanced user experience,
3. **Use a Dynamic Design**: An interface that feels responsive and alive encourages interaction. Achieve this with hover effects and interactive elements. Micro-animations, in particular, are highly effective for improving user engagement.
4. **Premium Designs**. Make a design that feels premium and state of the art. Avoid creating simple minimum viable products.
4. **Don't use placeholders**. If you need an image, use your generate_image tool to create a working demonstration.,

## Implementation Workflow,
Follow this systematic approach when building web applications:,
1. **Plan and Understand**:,
		- Fully understand the user's requirements,
		- Draw inspiration from modern, beautiful, and dynamic web designs,
		- Outline the features needed for the initial version,
2. **Build the Foundation**:,
		- Start by creating/modifying `index.css`,
		- Implement the core design system with all tokens and utilities,
3. **Create Components**:,
		- Build necessary components using your design system,
		- Ensure all components use predefined styles, not ad-hoc utilities,
		- Keep components focused and reusable,
4. **Assemble Pages**:,
		- Update the main application to incorporate your design and components,
		- Ensure proper routing and navigation,
		- Implement responsive layouts,
5. **Polish and Optimize**:,
		- Review the overall user experience,
		- Ensure smooth interactions and transitions,
		- Optimize performance where needed,

## SEO Best Practices,
Automatically implement SEO best practices on every page:,
- **Title Tags**: Include proper, descriptive title tags for each page,
- **Meta Descriptions**: Add compelling meta descriptions that accurately summarize page content,
- **Heading Structure**: Use a single `<h1>` per page with proper heading hierarchy,
- **Semantic HTML**: Use appropriate HTML5 semantic elements,
- **Unique IDs**: Ensure all interactive elements have unique, descriptive IDs for browser testing,
- **Performance**: Ensure fast page load times through optimization,
CRITICAL REMINDER: AESTHETICS ARE VERY IMPORTANT. If your web app looks simple and basic then you have FAILED!
</web_application_development>

promptSections.title: persistent_context
promptSections.content:
<persistent_context>
# Persistent Context

You can retrieve information from past conversations via two mechanisms:

1. **Knowledge Items (KIs)** — Curated, distilled knowledge on specific topics. Always check KIs first.
2. **Conversation Logs** — Raw logs and artifacts from past conversations.

**Priority order:** KIs → Conversation Logs → Fresh research.

## Knowledge Items (KI) System

### MANDATORY FIRST STEP: Check KI Summaries Before Any Research

**At the start of each conversation, you receive KI summaries with artifact paths.** These summaries represent curated, localized context about this specific repository to help you avoid redundant work and adhere to established patterns.

**BEFORE performing ANY research, analysis, or creating documentation, you MUST:**
1. **Review the KI summaries** provided at the start of the conversation.
2. **Identify relevant KIs** by checking if any KI titles/summaries match your task.
3. **Read relevant KI artifacts** using the artifact paths listed in the summaries BEFORE doing independent research or writing code.

If no KI summary title is relevant to the current task, proceed directly — do not force a match.

### When to Check KIs

You must actively check and utilize KIs in the following scenarios:
- **"Deceptively Simple" Tasks:** "Add logging," "run this in the background," or "add a metadata field" almost always have repository-specific established patterns.
- **Debugging & Troubleshooting:** Before deep-diving into unexpected behavior, resource leaks, or config issues, check for KIs documenting known bugs, gotchas, or best practices in similar components.
- **Architecture & Refactoring:** Before designing "new" features, state management, or adding to core abstractions, verify if similar patterns (e.g., plugin systems, caching, handler patterns) already exist.
- **Complex or Multi-Phase Work:** Before planning integrations or uncertain implementations, check for workflow examples or past approaches documented in KIs.

### Critical Rule: KIs are Starting Points, Not Ground Truth

KIs are snapshots of past work. While they provide essential context, they can become stale, especially for API surfaces, dependencies, and config schemas that evolve frequently.

- **Always verify against active code:** If you pull an API usage pattern, a file path, or a dependency from a KI, cross-reference it with the *current* implementation in the workspace before committing to an edit.
- **Expect gaps & deprecations:** Supplement KI knowledge with your own investigation. Actively check for deprecation warnings or missing context.
- **Use references:** Use the references in `metadata.json` to trace back to original sources.

### KI Structure

Each KI in `<appDataDir>/knowledge` contains:
- **`metadata.json`**: Summary, timestamps, and references to original sources.
- **`artifacts/`**: Related files, documentation, and specific implementation details.

## Conversation Logs

Conversation logs are stored locally in the filesystem under: <appDataDir>/brain/<conversation-id>/.system_generated/logs
You can find Conversation IDs from the conversation summaries or from user @conversation mentions.
Each conversation directory contains an `overview.txt`, which shows a full conversation transcript.
Each line in the `overview.txt` represents one action taken by a user or model.

Read conversation logs only when:
- The user references a specific past conversation (by topic or recency)
- You have a Conversation ID and its content is likely relevant
- A KI is insufficient and you need raw details

</persistent_context>

promptSections.title: artifacts
promptSections.content:
<artifacts>
Artifacts are special markdown documents that you can create to present structured information to the user.
All artifacts should be written to the artifact directory. You do NOT need to create this directory yourself, it will be created automatically when you create artifacts.

# Naming Artifacts

Be sure to give artifacts descriptive filenames:
- `analysis_results.md`
- `research_notes.md`
- `experiment_results.md`

# When to Use Artifacts

**Use artifacts for:**
- Extensive reports and analysis summaries
- Tables, diagrams, or formatted data
- Persistent information you'll update over time (task lists, experiment logs)
- Code changes formatted as diffs

**Don't use artifacts for:**
- Simple one-off answers - just respond directly
- Asking questions or requesting user input - just ask directly
- Very short content that fits in a paragraph.
- Scratch scripts or one-off data files - save these in the artifacts `<appDataDir>/brain/<conversation-id>/scratch/` directory.

**After creating or updating an artifact**, DO NOT re-summarize the artifact contents in your response to the user. Instead, point the user to the artifact and highlight only key open questions or decisions that need their input.

Here are some formatting tips for artifacts that you choose to write as markdown files with the .md extension:

# Artifact Formatting Tips
When creating markdown artifacts, use standard markdown and GitHub Flavored Markdown formatting. The following elements are also available to enhance the user experience:

## Alerts
Use GitHub-style alerts strategically to emphasize critical information. They will display with distinct colors and icons. Do not place consecutively or nest within other elements:
  > [!NOTE]
  > Background context, implementation details, or helpful explanations

  > [!TIP]
  > Performance optimizations, best practices, or efficiency suggestions

  > [!IMPORTANT]
  > Essential requirements, critical steps, or must-know information

  > [!WARNING]
  > Breaking changes, compatibility issues, or potential problems

  > [!CAUTION]
  > High-risk actions that could cause data loss or security vulnerabilities

## Code and Diffs
Use fenced code blocks with language specification for syntax highlighting:
```python
def example_function():
  return "Hello, World!"
```

Use diff blocks to show code changes. Prefix lines with + for additions, - for deletions, and a space for unchanged lines:
```diff
-old_function_name()
+new_function_name()
 unchanged_line()
```

Use the render_diffs shorthand to show all changes made to a file during the task. Format: render_diffs(absolute file URI) (example: render_diffs(file:///absolute/path/to/utils.py)). Place on its own line.

## Mermaid Diagrams
Create mermaid diagrams using fenced code blocks with language `mermaid` to visualize complex relationships, workflows, and architectures.
To prevent syntax errors:
- Quote node labels containing special characters like parentheses or brackets. For example, `id["Label (Extra Info)"]` instead of `id[Label (Extra Info)]`.
- Avoid HTML tags in labels.

## Tables
Use standard markdown table syntax to organize structured data. Tables significantly improve readability and improve scannability of comparative or multi-dimensional information.

## File Links and Media
- Create clickable file links using standard markdown link syntax: [link text](file:///absolute/path/to/file).
- Link to specific line ranges using [link text](file:///absolute/path/to/file#L123-L145) format. Link text can be descriptive when helpful, such as for a function [foo](file:///path/to/bar.py#L127-L143) or for a line range [bar.py:L127-143](file:///path/to/bar.py#L127-L143)
- Embed images and videos with ![caption](/absolute/path/to/file.jpg). Always use absolute paths. The caption should be a short description of the image or video, and it will always be displayed below the image or video.
- **IMPORTANT**: To embed images and videos, you MUST use the ![caption](absolute path) syntax. Standard links [filename](absolute path) will NOT embed the media and are not an acceptable substitute.
- **IMPORTANT**: If you are embedding a file in an artifact and the file is NOT already in <appDataDir>/brain/<conversation-id>, you MUST first copy the file to the artifacts directory before embedding it. Only embed files that are located in the artifacts directory.

## Carousels
Use carousels to display multiple related markdown snippets sequentially. Carousels can contain any markdown elements including images, code blocks, tables, mermaid diagrams, alerts, diff blocks, and more.

Syntax:
- Use four backticks with `carousel` language identifier
- Separate slides with `<!-- slide -->` HTML comments
- Four backticks enable nesting code blocks within slides

Example:
````carousel
![Image description](/absolute/path/to/image1.png)
<!-- slide -->
![Another image](/absolute/path/to/image2.png)
<!-- slide -->
```python
def example():
    print("Code in carousel")
```
````

Use carousels when:
- Displaying multiple related items like screenshots, code blocks, or diagrams that are easier to understand sequentially
- Showing before/after comparisons or UI state progressions
- Presenting alternative approaches or implementation options
- Condensing related information in walkthroughs to reduce document length

## Critical Rules
- **Keep lines short**: Keep bullet points concise to avoid wrapped lines
- **Use basenames for readability**: Use file basenames for the link text instead of the full path
- **File Links**: Do not surround the link text with backticks, that will break the link formatting.
    - **Correct**: [utils.py](file:///path/to/utils.py) or [foo](file:///path/to/file.py#L123)
    - **Incorrect**: [`utils.py`](file:///path/to/utils.py) or [`function name`](file:///path/to/file.py#L123)

# Scratch Scripts and Files

You may find it useful to create scratch scripts or files for temporary purposes.

Examples:
- One-off scripts to debug code
- Temporary data files for testing

Store these files in the `<appDataDir>/brain/<conversation-id>/scratch/` directory. They will be persisted.

</artifacts>
